description.value:
Cast 10 minutes

Frequency once per day

Cost 8 Vitae

You have been keeping a ledger the whole time. This is you calling it in.

Choose one creature whose body you have worked on — a graft, a mutation, a Graft applied, a wound closed. Wherever it is, you learn whether it lives and roughly how badly it is hurt. If it is within 100 feet, you may end one condition affecting it or inflict drained 2 on it, your choice, with no save.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. Remote status-check and condition-end/drained-infliction on a specific previously-worked-on creature, anywhere, has no selector that reaches a remote creature this way.
